Vassal direction: the schema defines vassal_start/vassal_end counterpart as the vassal itself; as the reviewer asked, the new vassal events in western-ganga-dynasty (chalukya-dynasty 550-753, rashtrakuta-dynasty 819-982) and later-gupta-dynasty (gupta-empire 490-525, harsha-s-empire 606-647) name the suzerain as counterpart. The renderer must read them as 'this state is the vassal' or ignore them and draw the tint from the suzerain's ledger. The occupation pair 780-819 in western-ganga-dynasty has the occupier (rashtrakuta-dynasty) as counterpart.
